# Post-install fixes of sevenx_multisite

This page is for developers who maintain or copy the `sevenx_multisite` installer, and for administrators who want to
understand a log line from the install. It answers: what the two hook files do, and what each repair after the
content import is for. The step numbers refer to the table on
[The multisite installer script](the-multisite-installer-script.md#phase-4-the-post-install-steps).

## Contents

1. [install-scripts.php](#install-scriptsphp)
2. [post-install-fix.php](#post-install-fixphp)
3. [Repairs of the imported data](#repairs-of-the-imported-data)
4. [Nodes, layouts, menus and tags](#nodes-layouts-menus-and-tags)
5. [URL aliases and site prefixes](#url-aliases-and-site-prefixes)
6. [Class names](#class-names)

## install-scripts.php

`settings/install-scripts.php` defines the two hooks `CreateSites` (`kernel/setup/steps/ezstep_create_sites.php`)
calls around the package install:

```php
function eZSitePreInstall( )
{
    $installer = new sevenxMultiSiteInstaller( array( 'var_dir' => 'var/site' ) );
    $installer->preInstall();
}

function eZSitePostInstall( &$parameters )
{
    $installer = new sevenxMultiSiteInstaller( $parameters );
    $installer->postInstall();
}
```

`CreateSites` calls `eZSitePreInstall( $siteType )` after including the settings files and before it installs the
required packages, and `eZSitePostInstall( $parameters )` at the end, with the content language temporarily set to
the clean data's language ("in the primary language every dataMap() of an eng-US object came back empty"). After the
post-install it checks `eZSiteInstaller::abortedStep()` and reports `EZSW-080` when a step stopped the chain. What
`preInstall()` does is on [The multisite installer script](the-multisite-installer-script.md#phase-2-the-pre-install).

## post-install-fix.php

`settings/post-install-fix.php` (1050 lines) is loaded by the installer with `require_once`; it is not a
`<settings-file>`. Its header says why it is separate: "Keep all non-interactive DB normalization here so the
installer and build_reference can share the same logic." Every function is wrapped in `if ( !function_exists(...) )`.

| Function | Used by step | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `sevenxSitePackageName()` | | the folder name above `settings/`: `sevenx_multisite` or `sevenx_multisite_clean` |
| `sevenxDemocontentPackageName()` | | the required package whose name starts with `sevenx_multisite_democontent`, read from the site package's `package.xml` |
| `sevenxDemocontentObjectDir()` | | that package's `ezcontentobject/` folder in the repository |
| `sevenxFixPackageNodesAndExplayouts()` | 35 | nodes, layout references, menus, tags, embeds, cache |
| `sevenxSetSiteInfoMenuNodeIDs()` | | a stub that returns `true` |
| `sevenxFixMenuINIFiles()` | 35 | `menu.ini.append.php` of each site siteaccess |
| `sevenxClearLinksToContentNotInstalled()` | 40 | block links to missing pages |
| `sevenxCleanStaleUrlTextAttributes()` | 37 | stale `url_text` values |
| `sevenxRegenerateURLAliases()` | 38 | URL aliases of every node |
| `sevenxFixEmbeddedObjectIDs()` | 35 | `<embed>` and `<embed-node>` ids in rich text |
| `sevenxFixEzTagsFromPackage()` | 35 | tag attributes |
| `sevenxRepairClassNameLists()` | 45 | class name lists keyed by number |

"The only difference between the two installations is the content package the site package requires", so the same
file serves `sevenx_multisite` and `sevenx_multisite_clean`.

## Repairs of the imported data

These steps run early, because they only need the objects and "several later steps are fragile":

| Step | Repair |
|---|---|
| 3 `postInstallFixContentObjectNameLanguages` | puts the language id of every `ezcontentobject_name` and `ezcontentobject_attribute` row in line with its locale, keeping the always-available bit, then rebuilds the language masks of versions and objects from their attributes. Without it, lookups that join the name table miss and "executeSteps aborts the rest of the install" |
| 4 `postInstallResolveRelationListIds` | relation list items arrive as `<relation-item contentobject-remote-id="...">`; each attribute is rebuilt through the datatype's `fromString()` with real object ids, and targets that are not installed are dropped |
| 5 `postInstallRekeyStarRatings` | moves the seeded `ezstarrating` row onto the installed "Test Product" (remote id `af35e1174dab340acaddcff36cea57d3`) and restores its average of 4.3 |
| 41 `postInstallPlaceOrphanedPackageObjects` | gives a node to any package object that was published without one, reading the parent from the object file, in two passes |

## Nodes, layouts, menus and tags

Step 35 calls `sevenxFixPackageNodesAndExplayouts()`, which:

1. Reads the node assignments of every `object-media-o-*.xml` of the content package and creates the nodes that are
   still missing, resolving parents by remote id, in up to 50 passes. This builds the map from package node and object
   ids to the ids of this installation.
2. Remaps the `explayouts_*` and `eztags_attribute_link` references and removes those that point at content the
   package does not ship (see [Layouts data and the share .dba files](layouts-data-and-share-dba.md#fitting-the-rows-to-the-new-installation)).
3. `sevenxFixMenuINIFiles()`: writes `settings/siteaccess/<sa>/menu.ini.append.php` for `site`, `eng`,
   `sevenx_site_user` (Fit & Healthy) and `bold`, `bold_ger` (Bold Agency), with `[SiteInfo]` `RemoteID`
   (`media-o-site-info` or `media-o-site-info-bold`), `MainMenuID[]`, `NexusMainMenuID[]`, `FooterMenuID[]`,
   `NexusFooterMenuID[]`, `PrivacyPolicyID` and `CookiePolicyID`. Each list starts with a bare `Key[]` line so it
   replaces the theme's list instead of being appended to it; a page the package did not install is left out. The ids
   are written into the project's siteaccess settings, not into the theme extension.
4. `sevenxFixEzTagsFromPackage()`: stores every `eztags` attribute again from the strings in the object file, and
   raises the priority of rule 50 to 175.
5. `sevenxFixEmbeddedObjectIDs()`: rewrites numeric `object_id` and `node_id` of embeds in `ezxmltext` fields.
6. Clears all caches with `eZCache::clearAll()`, because "the first page views were served from caches built before
   these fixes".

The installer method then clears the layout resolver cache.

## URL aliases and site prefixes

Each site lives below its own home node and hides it with `PathPrefix`, so its URLs need aliases that start with the
prefix:

| Step | What it does |
|---|---|
| 37 `postInstallCleanUrlText` | empties `url_text` values that do not match the object's name (showcase pages keep theirs) |
| 38 `postInstallRegenerateURLAliases` | calls `updateSubTreePath()` for every node except node 1, without emptying the alias tables first: emptying them "removes the root elements the content tree hangs from" |
| 39 `postInstallCreateSitePrefixAliases` | stores the prefixed path of every node below `media-n-939` and `media-n-940`, per language of the home node, never touching the home node's own element |
| 42 `postInstallSetSiteHomeAndPrefix` | writes `ForceVirtualHost=true`, `PathPrefix`, `IndexPage`, `DefaultPage` and `RootNodeDepth` for `site`, `bold`, `bold_ger` and the translations, copies the menus to the translations, and points the empty path alias at the Fit & Healthy home |

## Class names

| Step | Repair |
|---|---|
| 44 `postInstallResyncContentClassNames` | rebuilds `ezcontentclass.serialized_name_list` from the `ezcontentclass_name` rows for classes whose list holds no name, so class lists and create menus stop showing a blank |
| 45 `postInstallRepairClassNameLists` | moves names and descriptions stored under key `0` (written while no content language existed) to the class's language; idempotent |

## Reading the log

The fixes log through `eZDebug::writeNotice()`, one summary line each, for example "Created N missing tree nodes in N
pass(es)", "References to content ... does not ship, removed: ...", "Regenerated URL aliases for N nodes, N changed",
"Stored N prefixed URL alias path(s)", "Switched off N block link(s) to pages this installation does not have". On a
clean install the "removed" counts are expected; on a full install they should be zero.
